channels.formes: v2, with topology and relative scale

reading: Repetition helps every division except religious scenes, at every weight tried. Division 1 is best without it at 1432 and degrades to 1740 at the kindest weight. The likely reason is that the same episode is staged with different numbers of figures -- an Annunciation with two figures and one with angels and architecture share a subject and not a multiplicity profile -- so counting actively misleads where the subject does not fix the count. Topology and relative scale give only marginal gains: division 2 moves 458 to 450, division 9 1943 to 1727.
